title: Stonehenge Training Anchor Authority
objective: Import and validate the user-reported Stonehenge training anchor as the second calibration correspondence, under the privacy firewall.

repository_truth.head: de620bb
reused_engine: cwatlas.geodesy (geodetic_to_ecef), cwatlas.uncertainty (propagate_circle), cwatlas.provenance_ledger (hash chain), cwatlas.r1082.route_core (parse_five_token), cwatlas.r1082.source_import (opaque fixture id) - NOT reimplemented

negative_results: The anchor is a user-reported OPERATOR_SELECTION over a SOURCE claim; it is NEVER MEASURED. refuse_as_measured() and promote_to(MEASURED/REPLICATED) both raise via claims.refuse_candidate_as_measured.
A zero-area (point) uncertainty region is refused at construction: a training anchor is a region, never invented precision.
The public projection carries only the opaque id, the sanitised public route shape, the synthetic public coordinate, and the uncertainty footprint - never a private label or narrative.
A training anchor is never scored as a holdout prediction.

claims.statement: The user-reported Stonehenge correspondence (route 01|65|87|65|23) is imported as a training anchor bound to a synthetic public coordinate with non-zero positional uncertainty, referenced by an opaque id and bound to the hash-chained provenance ledger.

privacy_check: CLEAN - opaque fixture id + synthetic public coordinate only; no private path literals, no personal identity tokens, no raw private vector or narrative; privacy.scan_for_private clean
